reviews.text: We performed the second orthopedic surgery on our dog. Once again, Dr. Bruno and the team were exceptional and impeccable. We unconditionally trust their professionalism and dedication. The post-surgical follow-up is also perfect.
Excellent professionals, Dr. Bruno diagnosed my Lili and we are treating her, God willing everything will be alright. Thank you all.

I wanted to express my gratitude to the entire team! They are all wonderful!! My dog ​​had surgery on her paw and from the beginning, I received excellent care and guidance. We had close follow-up care, even after the surgery; everyone kept in touch and showed affection and concern to ensure a perfect recovery! I will be eternally grateful to this team 🩵

I would like to express our gratitude to Dr. Bruno and his wonderful team. Suki underwent emergency surgery, and they were so helpful and did an impeccable job. We even created a group to stay informed, and they were always so attentive to us from beginning to end.

We had a wonderful experience! Excellent professionals! They explained the procedures very well. The post-surgical support was outstanding!! They deserve congratulations, and we will recommend them to everyone!!!

Overflowing with gratitude! 🙏❤️

My heart is overflowing with joy seeing my Robson doing well and recovering so beautifully from surgery!

My special thanks go to Dr. Bruno, orthopedic surgeon at Clínica Ortoderm. Thank you for your competence, professionalism, and all the care and attention you gave my boy. You were exceptional from beginning to end!

I also thank the entire Clínica Ortoderm team, from the receptionists, who always welcomed us so warmly, to all the professionals who cared for Robson during surgery and post-operatively.

You were angels during a very delicate time for us. Thank you for restoring Robson's health and joy!

I highly recommend Clínica Ortoderm.
This place was awful! A friend of mine, Victor, recommended it to me, but unfortunately it was a terrible experience.

My Sheltie, Volpe, underwent femoral head scraping surgery and castration surgery with Dr. Bruno Lins' team on June 26th. Everything went smoothly! 🙏🏻 Dr. Bruno is an experienced surgeon. The anesthesiologist was very attentive and instilled a lot of confidence (Dr. Thiago Tanaka Rodrigues). Dr. Bruno's wife, veterinarian Dr. Karina Cantagallo, provided full support in the post-operative period. We already knew Dr. Karina. Three years ago, she diagnosed Volpe with hypothyroidism, extremely high triglycerides and cholesterol, and a gallbladder with obstructive sludge at very high risk of rupture. All this in a 3-year-old asymptomatic dog!!! I highly recommend the clinic.

My experience with the clinic was excellent! My pet underwent successful surgery. The post-operative follow-up was great! I had support whenever I needed it, and the follow-up appointments were important for monitoring the recovery. I was well taken care of by everyone at the clinic. My pet recovered very well; he is walking normally again and seems to be in no more pain. I thank the clinic and Dr. Bruno for the success of the surgery!

Dr. Bruno saved our Lola twice. The first time was in 2022, when she was unfortunately hit by a car and needed surgery. Lola is a 1.5 kg Yorkie and, at the time of the accident, had recently been spayed, only 4 days post-surgery. The surgery was a success and today she walks perfectly.

Later, Lola developed megacolon (unrelated to the accident) and, last month, needed to undergo a subtotal colectomy. Our Lola had no quality of life before the surgery: she needed weekly enemas and was in a lot of pain. Today she is very healthy, doing her business normally and very happy.

We are extremely grateful to Dr. Bruno and also to Dr. Karina, who have always been very attentive and competent.
